import ctypes
from ctypes import c_void_p, c_char_p

# Load the dynamic libraries in the correct order
libgslcblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
libgsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_root_fdfsolver_alloc and gsl_root_fdfsolver_free functions
libgsl.gsl_root_fdfsolver_alloc.restype = c_void_p
libgsl.gsl_root_fdfsolver_alloc.argtypes = [c_void_p]

libgsl.gsl_root_fdfsolver_free.restype = None
libgsl.gsl_root_fdfsolver_free.argtypes = [c_void_p]

# Define the gsl_root_fdfsolver_type structure
class gsl_root_fdfsolver_type(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("name", c_char_p),
        ("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("set", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, c_void_p, c_void_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))),
        ("iterate", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, c_void_p, c_void_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)))
    ]

# Define the assert_test function
def assert_test():
    # Create a dummy gsl_root_fdfsolver_type object
    dummy_solver_type = gsl_root_fdfsolver_type()
    dummy_solver_type.size = 1  # Set a non-zero size for allocation

    # Allocate a gsl_root_fdfsolver object
    solver = libgsl.gsl_root_fdfsolver_alloc(ctypes.byref(dummy_solver_type))

    # Check if the allocation was successful
    assert solver is not None, "Failed to allocate gsl_root_fdfsolver object."

    # Free the allocated gsl_root_fdfsolver object
    libgsl.gsl_root_fdfsolver_free(solver)

    # If no exceptions were raised, the test passed
    print("Allocation and deallocation of gsl_root_fdfsolver object succeeded.")
